title: The Sonnet orchestrator trial section also holds the figures of the finished SP-rrqlgiff orchestrator session's result JSON
goal: kb/_self/token-efficiency.md's Sonnet orchestrator trial section quotes total_cost_usd, num_turns and duration_ms from r240-SP-rrqlgiff.json (the finished session's result JSON), beside the figures it holds as of the claim, and names what the review and close added to the sprint's stops and hand fixes

run:
import re
t = open("kb/_self/token-efficiency.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
m = re.search(r"(?m)^.*Sonnet orchestrator trial.*$", t)
assert m, "no Sonnet orchestrator trial section"
rest = t[m.start():]
nxt = re.search(r"(?m)^#{1,3} ", rest[m.end() - m.start():])
sec = rest[: (m.end() - m.start()) + nxt.start()] if nxt else rest
assert re.search(r"total_cost_usd\D{0,12}\d", sec) and "num_turns" in sec, "the trial section holds no figure from the final result JSON of the SP-rrqlgiff orchestrator"
